policy: Approved paired evaluation: retain the untouched pinned positive corpus and all raw findings. Apply only these exact reviewed source changes to separate copies. Keep quiet thresholds unchanged. Source signatures do not prove application exploitability; these reference variants are not vendor patches or API-parity claims.

action_pin_evidence.method: git ls-remote over HTTPS; exact refs/tags/<original ref>, its peeled ^{} ref, and refs/heads/<original ref> only
action_pin_evidence.identity_note: tag_and_branch means both exact names were advertised at the same commit; matching_refs retains both identities. Branch-specific refs were not replaced. Peeled annotated-tag commits take precedence over tag objects when advertised.

packages.variant_provenance: Linux GitHub Actions run 39741128857 and locally verified Windows wheel, exact same package/version; unmodified paired copies must preserve their actual original bytes.

replacements.reason: Shell-free reference profile: a string denotes one executable path; compound shell command strings are intentionally no longer supported. Not a drop-in vendor patch.
Disable OS shell interpretation; consumers needing arguments must supply an argv sequence. This does not establish untrusted input in the original library.
